changelog: Upgraded to 1.5.4.0: Exposed all 31 Video Editor tools as direct non-nested buttons without using the word Open, added explicit Apply confirmation so video sliders/markers never auto-apply before Apply, fixed TalkBack announcements and button semantics across Start/End/Loop/Zoom/marker controls, and added pro audio DSP/WAV export tools while keeping existing Audio Editing workflow unchanged.
